title: Canonical identity comparison for finite coefficient scalar restriction
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme and use its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $R$ be a finite commutative ring, and let $R_T$ be its constant ring sheaf, with the constant-ring module convention of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Write $\operatorname{Res}_{1_R}$ for restriction of scalars along the identity of $R_T$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Define $\iota_{T,R}:\operatorname{Res}_{1_R}\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathrm{id}$ on $R_T$-module sheaves to be the sectionwise identity comparison, transported through the canonical equivalence between fixed-scalar module sheaves and intrinsic constant-ring modules. On the entire unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], define $\iota^D_{T,R}:D(\operatorname{Res}_{1_R})\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathrm{id}$ by exact termwise localization of $\iota_{T,R}$ followed by the canonical identification $D(\mathrm{id})\cong\mathrm{id}$.
